13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

13417|8fca8484.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251902|243962a6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|243962a6.text:
The Cult? They are zealots and killers. They believe that we are being punished for some unspecific sin. The reality is that those that lead them are opportunists leftover from a dubious order of so-called "Priests" of Al'Akir, the Windlord. 

They now find themselves in a position to weaponize the fear of our people to consolidate their own power... and they have been quick to do so.

251902|70d67c67.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|70d67c67.text:
Many disagree on this point. I believe that simple communication is the key. The songs of the wind rang so clearly to us when the spirits were still here. Since they left, it's grown quiet and our power as windshapers has weakened. 

However, there are those of us who can still hear something. A hushed tone. Fragments of a melody. Those that can still hear and see into the elemental planes must grow in strength. I believe that is the key to our salvation.

251902|9162c2da.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|9162c2da.text: Where to begin? Our home is failing. The wards have fallen and the three provinces have begun to drift apart. There was a time not long ago when the spires of Shen'dramar were visible from the western watchtower. No longer. The anchor pylons are weakening, and if the chains finally break...

251902|96f13309.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|96f13309.text:
Why is this happening? Put simply, the spirits of the wind just... vanished. They were there one day, and they were gone the next. I can't quite describe the feeling that we windshapers felt when it happened. It was as if a great silence fell over all of us and then... a profound absence.

The petty wraiths you've likely encountered out there are just shades of the glory of the true spirits of wind. Non-sentient, aimless, and a far cry from the kindly spirits we lived in harmony alongside for thousands of years.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

253474|db018659.name: Peacekeeper
253474|db018659.text: The town medic can be found inside the tower on the northeast edge of Valanaar.

254149|d4fd4f24.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|d4fd4f24.text:
<The skyborne before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor, you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now it's unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded!

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

257005|c65683ed.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257006|cc01e817.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|cc01e817.text: It appears the winds have brought you my way! I am happy to train you in the ways of cooking if you have the inclination to learn.

257006|d682c422.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|d682c422.text: E borne hir ash nuff garde re ruff vassild lon thorniss, far E regen E majis barad ras aetwinter lo ruftos ergin.

257007|1a6886aa.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257008|358b7a1a.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|358b7a1a.text: Re, y ealdor Regenthor. Hir ras novaedi re uden va y vandar thorniss? Melka E gol ruff ras y garde va vil?

257008|d62b45b0.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

262502|3e8465bb.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|3e8465bb.text: When I heard that there was a whole new gaggle of elves literally fallin' from the sky, I said to myself "THAT'S where I need to be". A whole new society of impressionable, bright-eyed suckers... er--customers!

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

3296|10e6748a.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|10e6748a.text: Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5784|1a4f8770.name: Waldor
5784|1a4f8770.text: Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.
